I'll read both files completely before judging.Based on my complete reading of both files, I verified every concrete claim and citation key against the source findings.

The section is a faithful, well-attributed synthesis. Each `\textcite`/`\parencite` maps to findings tagged with the matching citation_key:
- Watershed hydrology claims (Schilling2008/2012, Sloan2016/2017, Fonley2021, BolandBrien2014) match findings 14–26, 40–42, 78–80.
- Mapping/cataloguing (Amado2018, Naz2009, Schilling2019, Valayamkunnath2020, Zhou2025) match findings 33–39, 63–66, 69, 83.
- Model routines/parameterisation (Williams2016, Guo2018b, Moriasi2012, Nelson2018, Chen2016, Boles2015, Bauwe2016, Qi2018, Mohanty1998, DeSchepper2015, Garrison1999, Muma2017, Nazari2021) all match.
- Preferential flow, phosphorus, sediment, management, seasonality, and tracer sections all map correctly (King2015/2016/2018, Zimmer2016, Clement2017, Ruark2009, Grangeon2021, Gaillot2023b, Ahiablame2010, Kokulan2021, BACKLUND1995, Fortin2002, Trentman2020, Millar2025, Rimidis2003, Frederiksen2023).

No unsupported numbers, invented results, or swapped keys were found. Technical expansions (NSE = Nash–Sutcliffe efficiency; HNABs = harmful and nuisance algal blooms; DEP_IMP; LATKSATF) are consistent with the findings.
